name: 我的高冷女友 MY COLD GIRLFRIEND
detailed_description:
This is a visual novel about the love story between 'you' and An Ran.

A simple dare at a class party—a joke confession to the most untouchable girl in school—was never meant to be taken seriously.
But when she said "yes"... everything changed.

You’re just an ordinary college student who got dragged into a game of Truth or Dare. When tasked with confessing to a girl of your choice, you jokingly pick the cold and quiet beauty, An Ran—known to everyone as the "ice queen." To your shock, she accepts.
And then, out of nowhere, she moves in with you. As your new housemate.

From awkward cohabitation to heart-fluttering daily moments—
Walk to school together, carry her on your bike for the first time, watch as her frosty exterior melts into shy glances and sweet words.
She may look cool and distant, but behind closed doors... she’s warm, caring, and full of surprises.

This isn’t just a love story born from a dare—it’s a journey through the quiet yet unforgettable days with your cold (and dangerously cute) girlfriend.

Features:

  • 💗 A romantic comedy about an ice-cold beauty and a completely average guy

  • 🏠 Unexpected cohabitation with the school’s most mysterious girl

  • 💫 Emotionally rich storytelling that explores growth, affection, and inner warmth

  • 🎙️ Fully voiced with immersive CG scenes to bring every heartbeat to life

  • 🌸 Sweet daily life + soft ecchi moments, perfect for fans of wholesome (yet thrilling) romance!

short_description: What's It Like to Have a Girlfriend with a Hidden Side? 💙A romantic comedy visual novel set in a modern campus, where a dare leads to an unexpected relationship with a cold beauty—and a sweet, chaotic cohabitation begins.
reviews:
““反差”就像冬夜的棉被，夏日的西瓜，是恋爱高手的最爱：从天降新人的喜上眉梢开始，小心地凿开冰封背后的秘密，独享始料未及的蜜糖奔流——在《我的高冷女友》的故事里，你将体验到一场就算完全剧透也欲罢不能的，每个老男孩都曾幻想过的恋爱关系和浪漫结局。”
LSP企划屋
